name: DR Congo
dossier:
The DR Congo national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Leopards, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 46 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A historic name reborn, hungry to honour a pioneering legacy.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, DR Congo will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group K and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group K. The connection between Yoane Wissa and Silas Katompa is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Yoane Wissa - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: DR Congo are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: As Zaire in 1974, they were the first Black African nation to reach a World Cup  -  now they return transformed.
DR Congo boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage as Zaire (1974).
